items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: Bennie Moten's band was playing more and they made $16.50.

ctx.x: Twenty-two dollars and fifty cents, that is.
And I only worked 4 hours a night with tips. And Bennie Moten's band was playing more and they made $16.50.
Bennie Moten was a great pianist, wasn't he?
